name: trello-mcp
description: Self-hostable Model Context Protocol server for Trello.

scripts.build:clean: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.verify: tsc --noEmit && biome check . && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && vitest run
scripts.verify:coverage: tsc --noEmit && biome check . && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && vitest run --coverage
